//Serilog: EF logs every executed statement at Information under Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command.
At production traffic that is several lines per request, which buries what an operator is looking
for and costs real money in log storage. Warning still surfaces connection failures, retries and
concurrency violations. Npgsql is the same reasoning one layer down. appsettings.Development.json
turns both back up, because per-statement SQL on a dev machine is the point rather than the problem.
System.Net.Http.HttpClient is a SECRET-HANDLING override, not a noise one, and it stays at Warning in
EVERY environment file: IHttpClientFactory logs the full request URL at Information, and the Telegram
Bot API carries its token IN the URL path (https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage). At
Information every OTP delivered by DM wrote the bot token into the log in plaintext.
NOTE: comment keys must live OUTSIDE MinimumLevel.Override — Serilog parses every value in that
map as a log level and throws at startup on anything that is not one.

Otlp.//: Set an OTLP collector endpoint (e.g. http://otel-collector:4317) to enable OTLP export. Empty = disabled; the host does not require a collector to run.
